statements.status_notes: Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport fixes Encrypt-then-MAC heap overflow (upstream commit 42e33d81577ed4b95d4b4f6f845e5ee8efe5eeb4). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66035

Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport adds publickey response bounds checking (upstream commit a13bb6c773f0d55ad1628cede57e99803cd898d9). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66034
Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport fixes AES-GCM integer underflow (upstream commit a2ed82d40964bbc0d64cd717aa0a5a892117d2e6). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66033

Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-5 backport nulls the SFTP data pointer after free (upstream commit 5e4776146552d898b9c0e1b313cd093fa8dc92d0). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66032

Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-6 backport initializes publickey list entries before use (upstream commit 32092f0d310f4d769e5ed073ad5987f997f446dc). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58051
Debian sid libssh2 1.11.1-6 backport caps publickey attribute list size (upstream commit 34497525929b9a47f03dfb81887ac896202b7e12). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58050

The DHI libssh2 APK backports the upstream sftp_symlink heap buffer over-read fix from https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/2dae3024897e1898d389835151f4e9606227721d plus prerequisite and regression follow-up patches, matching Debian DSA-6365-1. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-15661
